_comment: JEXI MCP server registry v3 (Sept 2026 — Lewis: connect them directly, no switches). Every server here was REALLY connected and tool-called by the live test (scripts/mcp-live-test.js, multiple rounds). No paid keys anywhere. uvx servers need Python+uv on the host; npx needs node; streamable-http needs only network. A memory-guarded few wake at boot; the rest connect lazily on first use — mcp/tool-directory.json lets the planner see every tool without holding 35 child processes. Phase 8 Scope F (Sept 2026): the 9 `category: security` additions (plus the security-marked `playwright`) are registered DECLARATIVELY from verified upstream sources — mcp-nmap and semgrep-mcp verified as published PyPI packages, the rest verified upstream GitHub repos. They are enabled:false (keyless where marked is a property of the tool, not an install claim) and were NOT live-verified in the build sandbox — enable only on a host that has provisioned the underlying tool.

servers.notes: permanently-declarative schemas upgraded in FINAL GAP 3: the six forgejo.* schemas are served live by the stdio bridge server/mcp/servers/forgejo-bridge.js (initialize/tools/list/tools/call; FORGEJO_URL + FORGEJO_TOKEN env; honest not-configured answers until set).
servers.keylessNote: forge tokens ride via keyRef (env var name or keyring ref), per the madtea credential discipline

declaredTools.name: forgejo.list_repos
declaredTools.description: List repositories visible to the configured token (GET /api/v1/repos/search).

declaredTools.name: forgejo.get_repo
declaredTools.description: One repository (GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}).

declaredTools.name: forgejo.list_issues
declaredTools.description: List issues (GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues?state=).

declaredTools.name: forgejo.create_issue
declaredTools.description: Create an issue (POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues).

declaredTools.name: forgejo.list_prs
declaredTools.description: List pull requests (GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=).

declaredTools.name: forgejo.get_pr
declaredTools.description: One pull request (GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}).
